items.text: jedálny lístok = menu
items.picture: Marek's restaurant in the evening: Emma, Lucia and Tomáš sit down at a table with a checked cloth and open big leather-bound menus; Emma studies hers with great concentration.

items.text: polievka = soup
items.picture: A deep bowl of steaming soup set in front of Tomáš at the restaurant table, a basket of bread beside it; he rubs his hands.

items.text: hlavné jedlo = main course
items.picture: Dušan the waiter sets three big plates of main courses on the restaurant table; Emma, Lucia and Tomáš lean back to make room.

items.text: kuracie mäso = chicken (meat)
items.picture: In the restaurant kitchen, Marek lifts a golden roast chicken out of the oven.

items.text: ryba = fish
items.picture: Emma tastes a grilled trout with a slice of lemon on her plate and nods: very good.

items.text: ryža = rice
items.picture: A plate of roast chicken with a neat dome of white rice; Marek adds a sprig of parsley on top.

items.text: hranolky = chips / French fries
items.picture: Tomáš, at the restaurant table, dips a chip into ketchup from a big heap of fries on his plate.

items.text: Čo si dáte? = What will you have?
items.picture: Dušan the waiter stands at the friends' table with his notepad and pen ready, smiling politely as Emma, Lucia and Tomáš look up from their menus.

items.text: Dám si polievku. = I'll have the soup.
items.picture: Emma points to a line on her menu and orders; Dušan writes it down.

items.text: Čo si dáte? A waiter says this. What does he want to know?
A na pitie? = And to drink?
items.picture: Dušan, pen still on his notepad, raises his eyebrows at Tomáš, who has turned to the drinks page of the menu.

items.text: Chutí ti? = Do you like it? (food)
items.picture: Mid-meal at the restaurant: Lucia leans over to Emma with a questioning look; Emma, her mouth full, gives an enthusiastic thumbs up.

items.text: Your soup is delicious. Lucia asks “Chutí ti?”. What do you say?
horúci = hot
items.picture: Tomáš blows on a steaming cup of tea that's far too hot to drink, pulling a face.

items.text: sladký = sweet
items.picture: Emma takes a bite of a slice of cake piled with whipped cream and chocolate, eyes closed in bliss.

items.text: slaný = salty
items.picture: Tomáš pulls a face after a spoonful of soup and pushes away the salt shaker; Lucia laughs.

items.text: Účet, prosím. = The bill, please.
items.picture: At the end of the meal, Dušan comes over to the table and Tomáš, getting up, asks him for the bill, his wallet already in his hand; Emma and Lucia finish their drinks.

items.text: Spolu alebo osobitne? = Together or separately?
items.picture: Dušan holds out the bill and a card reader and looks from one friend to the next; Lucia and Emma both reach for their purses.

items.text: The waiter asks “Spolu alebo osobitne?”. You're paying for everyone. What do you say?
Ako ideš domov? = How are you getting home?
items.picture: Late evening at a tram stop near Marek's restaurant, a tram pulling in: Emma, Lucia and Tomáš stand talking about how each of them is getting home.

items.text: Idem autobusom. = I'm going by bus.
pešo = on foot
items.picture: Lucia walks home along a quiet lamplit street, hands in her pockets, humming.

items.text: Cestujem s kamarátmi. = I travel with friends.
items.picture: Emma, Lucia and Tomáš sit together in a train compartment with backpacks on the rack, sharing snacks and laughing.

items.text: Where? pred, za, nad, pod, medzi
items.picture: Tomáš's untidy office: a lamp hangs above the desk, a bin sits under it, a printer stands between the desk and the shelves, and Tomáš, carrying a stack of boxes, stands behind his chair.

items.text: Ďakujem za pozvanie. = Thanks for the invitation.
items.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Tomáš on his phone outside the university. Right: Emma on hers in the dorm room, beaming and thanking him for the dinner invitation.

items.text: Tomáš says “Pozvem ťa na večeru.” What's a natural reply?
Dobre. = OK. / All right.
items.picture: At a table in the café near the university, Tomáš has just suggested a plan; Emma nods with a smile and gives a thumbs-up: OK, all right.

items.text: Tomáš says “Pozvem ťa na večeru.” You'd like to go. What do you say?
Polievka je veľmi slaná. What's wrong with the soup?
How do you ask for the bill?
You want to pay by card. What do you ask the waiter?
